label: peer-relay-official
method: lab/scripts/peer_relay_up.sh: tsr (official 1.94.2) runs `tailscale set --relay-server-port=40000`; direct UDP between ts1 (172.29.0.21) and ts2 (172.29.0.22) dropped with iptables in both containers; ts1 pings ts2 until the official client reports a peer-relay path, then status --json of ts1 and tsr and a 5-ping run.
note: lab-only keys; ts2 PeerRelay = 172.29.0.23:40000:vni:1, CurAddr empty; the first ping went via DERP, the second via the peer relay
